regimeSub: Fed expected to hold Wed despite 4% CPI; tech-to-bonds rotation extends as 10Y firms at 5%.

AI rotation extends per Asian Banker 'AI selloff drives Treasury rally' → SPX +0.7% DoD to 7676 as tech finds footing; VIX -0.5 to 18.39 signals vol compression into FOMC
